_comment: Optional operator catalog for the watch's ⌘ / 6:00 dial overlay (SPEC §12.3).
cp command_catalog.example.json command_catalog.json and edit; watchkit re-reads it per request.
Each row declares how the WATCH honors it, because the Runs API does not dispatch slash
commands — `POST /v1/runs` hands `input` to the model. honored: steer | stop | side | fork |
model | skill | client | status | prompt  (unknown values degrade to `prompt`, never a crash).
`requires` names a /v1/capabilities flag; the watch reads the live flags itself (it holds that
profile's key) and dims a row whose flag is false — watchkit never claims a feature it cannot
see, so `capabilities` here is only a fallback for a gateway that is unreachable.
An agent's skills do NOT belong here: watchkit adds them from profiles/<agent>/skills itself.

commands.name: steer
commands.desc: inject guidance into the run in flight

commands.name: btw
commands.desc: side conversation in a fork — keeps this thread clean

commands.name: deploy
commands.desc: gateway custom: /deploy from this box's CLI (sent to the model as a prompt)
